I'm checking how the 5b rule applies here: this register is kept by the licensing body and lists licence holders, so a legal name could be recorded at about 0.7 or lower unless there's an explicit label. The "Licensee" column header is arguably that kind of label, so I'm weighing whether to go up to 0.75 while keeping within the cap.

I'm settling on 0.85 for legal_name, since "licensee" is one of the labels the rule explicitly names. Trading As goes to trading_name, Licence Number to source_record_id and record_id, and the street address, suburb and postcode map to address.full, locality and postcode, with state set to VIC from the title. Coordinates, council, region, trading hours, licence category and patron capacity have no ontology home, and the postal address doesn't count as the registered address, so those stay unmapped. I still need to check that Licence Number is unique and look over the profile.
